newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 13.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on November 13. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The controversial comments made by Nobel laureate Bishop Belo to German magazine Der Spiegel came from an interview conducted five years ago. Youth groups protested yesterday in Jakarta over Belo's alleged comments that Indonesia treated East Timorese like "scabby dogs".
Indonesia's largest automobile manufacturer PT Astra Internasional is to build a 130 megawatt power plant in Palembang, South Sumatra.
Transportation firm PT Mitra Rajasa will sell 30 million new shares later this month in a move to expand its business.

Police are searching for two men suspected of involvement in an Ecstasy smuggling case that led to the arrest of an Indonesian actress in the United States last week. Zarima escaped to the United States after being arrested in Jakarta on possession charges this year.
Indonesia was the biggest foreign property buyer in Singapore so far this year, owning 419 of the 916 units sold. Malaysia was second and Hong Kong third.
